name: Slither Rock
summary: Slither Rock is a secluded cave tucked into the far northeastern cliffs of the Burning Steppes, past the perilous Terror Wing Path. It serves as the solitary refuge of Cyrus Therepentous, a sharp-tongued black dragonspawn with his own hidden agenda.

sections.title: A Secluded Cavern
sections.body: Tucked away in the scorched crags beyond the Terror Wing Path, Slither Rock is easy to overlook amid the fiery wastes of the Burning Steppes. Far from the roaring forges and marching orc warbands of Blackrock Spire, this remote hollow houses the solitary black dragonspawn Cyrus Therepentous. While dragonspawn are typically fiercely loyal soldiers of the Black Dragonflight, Cyrus maintains a strange, cantankerous independence here, willing to converse with mortal travelers rather than slaughtering them on sight—though never without a steady stream of insults.

faq.answer: Slither Rock is located in the far northeastern corner of the Burning Steppes. To reach it, travelers must navigate past the black dragonkin patrolling the Terror Wing Path.

The cave is home to Cyrus Therepentous, a solitary black dragonspawn. Unlike most of his kin who attack mortals immediately, Cyrus is willing to speak with outsiders, though he remains foul-tempered and derisive.

faq.q: Why would an adventurer seek out this cave?
faq.answer: Adventurers brave the perilous Terror Wing Path to seek the counsel and aid of Cyrus Therepentous. Despite his abrasive attitude, the dragonspawn shares common enemies with travelers opposing the Black Dragonflight and their dark masters.
